what_it_does: This work compresses spatiotemporal data (video-like sequences of 3D data over time) using a generative neural network model that combines dimensionality reduction with diffusion-based interpolation. The method stores key frames in compressed form and reconstructs intermediate frames synthetically, eliminating the need to store every single frame. Unlike existing compressors that store dense data, this approach generates missing frames on-demand, achieving better compression ratios for scientific datasets.
